tuning.name: VLLM_HUST_GMM_TUNING_CONFIG
tuning.grammar: **单值**正整数，白名单 {1,2,8,32}；逗号列表被显式拒绝（会破坏单臂单变量）
tuning.forwarding: 以 tuning_config=[value] 传入 apply_gmm1 / apply_gmm2 两处 npu_grouped_matmul；签名依据 torch_npu npu_grouped_matmul(..., int[]? tuning_config=None)
tuning.fail_fast: 首次 GMM 调用（起服 profile/dummy run 阶段，非 capture 内部）即解析并抛 ValueError；错误被缓存后每次调用继续抛出，不允许静默降级
tuning.disabled_effect: 零 import、零 IO、零额外 kwargs、零 shape 读取

dump.name: VLLM_HUST_GMM_COUNTS_DUMP
dump.value: 输出文件路径；支持 {rank} 占位符；无占位符且存在 RANK 时自动追加 .rank<RANK>（TP=2 两 rank 不共文件）
aux_env: VLLM_HUST_GMM_COUNTS_DUMP_MAX_PER_KEY（默认 2；每 (call_site, group_list_type, x_shape, w_shape, sample_source) 键的采样上限，只有成功写入才递增）
dump.records: meta 行 + 每样本：m/k/n/experts、x_shape/weight_shape、split_weight_list、need_trans、group_list_type、counts（归一化 counts）、group_list_raw（原始向量）、counts_len/counts_sum/nonzero_experts、phase、call_site、sample_source、capture_state、seq、pid/rank/local_rank、cohort/caliber
sample_source_values: eager：host 在 graph capture 之外执行本 Python 调用（可作为 fixture 候选）
skipped_inside_capture：capture 内 → 跳过，任何 device 读取都未发生；capture dummy 行绝不当真实 counts
skipped_unknown_capture_state：无法静态/运行时判定 capture 状态 → 同样跳过（fail-safe）
dump.capture_policy: 开启路径可 lazy import torch 做官方 capture 检测 torch.npu.is_current_stream_capturing()；检测为 capture 或检测失败时，在读取任何 device tensor 之前返回
dump.output_invariance: hook 恒返回 None 且不参与返回值构造；AST 门 test_call_sites_forward_output_unchanged 断言 op 结果原样返回
dump.error_policy: 写失败/路径不可用 → 仅 warning 一次（logger.warning）、不抛出、不伪造样本行；该错误不会被当成『门通过』
dump.disabled_effect: 零 IO、零 import、零 shape 读取、不建文件
dump.sampling_semantics: sample_source=eager means the host ran this Python call outside graph capture; inside capture the hook skips before any device read, so capture dummy rows are never recorded as counts; a FULL graph replay does not execute Python at all

notes.tuning_config_semantics: tuning_config 是 CANN GMM 的 tiling hint：数组首值表示『各专家预期处理的 token 数』。torch_npu 只承诺首值语义，故本补丁只接受单值，保证一个值=一臂；若要扫多值，必须逐值单独起服（一值一臂），不得在一臂内传列表。
notes.dump_window_status: The dump run is NOT a measurement window: it adds an env-gated hook plus file IO, i.e. a second variable. Its only product would be an immutable counts fixture for L0.
notes.fixture_blocker: active FULL graph 下 M=128 的真实 decode counts 无法经本 hook 取得（capture 内必须跳过，replay 不执行 Python），因此当前口径的完整 fixture 不可达；prefill eager 样本也不构成『完整 fixture 门已过』。
notes.why_tier2: 宿主公有面无 tuning_config 开关；两处调用点在宿主私有方法体内；插件侧复制方法体被仓内契约禁止；全局 monkeypatch torch_npu.npu_grouped_matmul 非已列公开面且影响所有 GMM 调用方。
notes.rollback: The w1r-gmm-tuning layer is REMOVED from the apply-runtime-patches.sh MANIFEST, so the script has no such layer name. If the runtime tree is still patched: (1) run `patch -R --dry-run` then `patch -R` against the already-verified patch.diff, or (2) re-add the layer per OWNERSHIP.md sec.5 and use apply-runtime-patches.sh --rollback. Never invent an unregistered layer name.
notes.cpu_gates: tests/test_w1r_gmm_tuning_patch.py（G-P0a..e/h 的 CPU 半 + F1/F2/F3/F6/F7/F8/F10 回归项）
notes.default_off_cost: default-off cost: no device difference, zero shape read, zero IO, zero import; every GMM call still performs two early-return Python calls (tuning kwargs lookup + dump early return). The host file text is not byte-identical (it carries the injected block): do not claim byte-equivalent or fully identical host behaviour.
notes.group_list_type_support: group_list_type=1 -> counts as-is; =0 -> cumsum bounds normalised to counts (raw kept); any other value -> counts=None with counts_normalization=unsupported_group_list_type and raw kept.
notes.split_weight_experts: when weight is a per-expert list/tuple, experts=len(weight) and the first element supplies K/N; a stacked [E,K,N] tensor uses shape[0].
